claim_ceiling: S3c-R2 implementation-choice and tuning-procedure evidence only; no environment-validity, baseline-power, gap, headroom, mechanism, learning-capability, agency, or EGO claim

candidates.description: Patch the R1 projection path to lower its estimate and leave the existing full-vocabulary feature code mostly intact.
candidates.evidence_it_would_produce: A faster-looking projection artifact and unchanged basic interface tests.
candidates.strongest_cheap_baseline_that_could_matc: A projection-only shortcut could satisfy artifact shape while leaving the actual sweep infeasible.
candidates.leakage_or_hardcoding_risk: High: it would tune around the compute line instead of implementing the frozen 001B F2 vocabulary, per-class measurement, and efficiency requirements.
candidates.smallest_falsifying_test: Require a persisted top-1024 fit-only vocabulary, incremental-vs-naive equivalence, per-class measurements, and thread/CPU assertions in the sweep entry path.
candidates.expected_failure_mode: Fails 001B as a report repair rather than a callable tuning procedure.

candidates.description: Replace GRU-class members with count-table or classifier recipes that emit plausible next-symbol distributions without teacher-forced one-pass sequence training.
candidates.evidence_it_would_produce: Quick internal-validation metrics and compact persisted recipes.
candidates.strongest_cheap_baseline_that_could_matc: The shortcut is itself a cheap same-access behavioral baseline, not the frozen S3c member family.
candidates.leakage_or_hardcoding_risk: Medium to high: it can avoid heldout leakage but silently substitutes member classes and erases the cost-class distinction the R2 projection must measure.
candidates.smallest_falsifying_test: Assert GRU-class measurement records declare teacher_forced_one_pass_per_sequence_per_epoch and CPU torch device enforcement.
candidates.expected_failure_mode: Invalid S3c battery because frozen member identities were replaced.

candidates.description: Implement the 001B delta exactly: top-1024 fit-only F2 vocabulary, incremental prefix feature materialization, GBT half fit-user budget, CPU/thread guards, six measured one-set cost classes, and the frozen sweep only if projection is under 24 CPU-h.
candidates.evidence_it_would_produce: Fresh vocabulary/projection/tuning/manifest artifacts or a preserved STOP manifest, with code hashes, wall-clock measurements, framework versions, and guard tests.
candidates.strongest_cheap_baseline_that_could_matc: Later S3d scoring may still show simpler access-parity baselines match these members; S3c-R2 only proves the member construction and tuning procedure ran under the frozen constraints.
candidates.leakage_or_hardcoding_risk: Main risks are fit/internal-val/heldout split leakage, accidental cross-session carryover in W15, action leakage in seq_full, GPU use, multi-thread accounting drift, and report literals not tied to callable producers.
candidates.smallest_falsifying_test: Run S3c guard tests, generate the vocabulary before tuning, verify projection arithmetic from six callable measurements, and stop if projection exceeds 24 CPU-h.
candidates.expected_failure_mode: Projection may still exceed the frozen compute line; that must become operator-decision evidence rather than an executor-side grid shrink.

selection_reason: It is the only candidate that preserves the 001A grids while applying the 001B efficiency and compute-accounting amendments without member substitution.
falsifier_for_current_framing: A measured R2 projection greater than 24 CPU-h falsifies executor authorization to run the sweep, not the broader environment hypothesis.
insufficient_evidence: Passing S3c tests alone is not S3d should-win evidence.
A tuning report without heldout access is still not environment-validity evidence.
A projection under the line does not prove baseline power or mechanism adequacy.
acceptance_signal: Fresh S3c-R2 tests pass and the callable projection either authorizes the frozen sweep or writes a preserved STOP manifest without touching prior STOP artifacts.
stop_condition: Projection > 24 CPU-h, missing required framework, undefined governing-spec decision, heldout access during S3c, or any frozen-source hash mismatch.
rollback_plan: Revert only this slice's source/test edits and preserve any generated STOP artifact as negative procedure evidence if a stop condition triggers.
forbidden_changes: No edits to frozen source documents.
No edits or deletion of prior S3c STOP artifacts.
No grid shrinking, member substitution, GPU use, heldout access, or EGO mainline integration.
